rubric.0: Absent or no qualifying evidence for this obligation
rubric.1: Placeholder, limited implementation, or blocking functional defect
rubric.2: Working implementation/model with substantial gaps or thin verification
rubric.3: Implemented and meaningfully tested; important scope/evidence gaps remain
rubric.4: Closed for the explicitly bounded obligation with no known remaining work

formula: sum(weight * grade / 4); weights sum to 100 per row; round to nearest 5 percentage points (ties upward)
limitations: Engineering prioritization estimates, not measured hardware fidelity, compatibility rates, test coverage or effort remaining. Medium confidence roughly +/-5 points; Low roughly +/-10 or more. Old percentages use a different undefined denominator and are not comparable deltas.
